resourceList.description: Map of resource name (e.g. cpu, memory) to Kubernetes resource quantity.

replicaCount.description: Number of Yopass server replicas to run. Keep at 1 unless using external/shared storage, since each pod runs its own in-pod Memcached sidecar with no shared cache.

image.description: Container image configuration for the Yopass server.

tag.description: Image tag. Defaults to the chart appVersion when empty.

yopass.description: Yopass server flags, mapped to CLI arguments.

listenAddress.description: Bind address for the server (maps to --address).

secretMaxLength.description: Maximum allowed encrypted secret size in bytes (maps to --max-length).

config.description: Frontend/runtime feature flags returned via /config and passed to the container as environment variables.

disable_upload.description: Disable file upload endpoints and UI (maps to --disable-upload).

prefetch_secret.description: Enable prefetch/status check for one-time secrets (maps to --prefetch-secret).

disable_features.description: Hide the "features" section on the homepage (maps to --disable-features).

no_language_switcher.description: Hide the language switcher in the UI (maps to --no-language-switcher).

metrics.description: Prometheus metrics server, served on a dedicated port (maps to --metrics-port).

enabled.description: Expose a Prometheus metrics endpoint on a dedicated container port and add prometheus.io/* pod annotations.

extraArgs.description: Additional CLI flags appended to the yopass-server args, e.g. license/OIDC/webhook/TLS flags not otherwise exposed by this chart.

extraEnv.description: Additional environment variables appended to the yopass container, as Kubernetes EnvVar objects.

extraEnvFrom.description: Additional envFrom sources for the yopass container, as Kubernetes EnvFromSource objects.

imagePullSecrets.description: Names of imagePullSecrets to use for pulling images.

nameOverride.description: String to partially override chart name.

fullnameOverride.description: String to fully override chart fullname.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the ServiceAccount.

name.description: Name of the ServiceAccount to use. If not set and create is true, a name is generated using the fullname template.

podAnnotations.description: Annotations to add to the Pod metadata.

securityContext.description: Container-level security context (capabilities, runAs*, readOnlyRootFilesystem, etc.).

port.description: Service port for the HTTP API/UI.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the Ingress.

host.description: Hostname to route through the Ingress.

tls.description: TLS configuration for the Ingress (secrets and hostnames).

resources.description: CPU/Memory resource requests/limits for the Yopass container. Left empty by default so it can run on resource-constrained environments.

tolerations.description: Tolerations for taints to schedule on matching nodes.

memcached.description: In-pod Memcached sidecar configuration, used as the (ephemeral) storage backend for secrets.

tag.description: Memcached image tag. Must be explicitly set (no default/latest fallback); the chart fails to render if empty.

resources.description: CPU/Memory resource requests/limits for the Memcached sidecar.
